tasks.short: Organise, promote and lead recreational activities

steps.what: Organize recreational activities and record agreed practical arrangements
Prepare, check and issue activity invitations to promote interest
Lead recreational activities and encourage participation in arts, sports and hobbies

tasks.design: Reuse invitation sections in {DOCS} from a practical activity brief and send through {EMAIL} after checking the final message. Retain organisation decisions, personal encouragement and all live activity leadership.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same practical details are rewritten for recurring activity invitations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document reuse can reduce repetitive assembly without choosing activities or leading groups.
tasks.still_hard: Encouraging participation and adapting the event when needs change.
tasks.human_edge: The worker notices exclusion, builds confidence and responds to the group.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated invitation entry; activity responsibility remains unchanged.

reach.role: exercise trainer and group fitness instructor
reach.task: Clarify suitability of an advertised exercise activity
reach.learn: Accurate activity descriptions and referral boundaries

evidence.claim: Reusable document sections can reduce repeated invitation assembly; the proposed recreation allocation is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is practical organisation, promotion and delivery; substantive assessment and planning are separate.
Worker in s1 records title, date, times, venue, capacity, intended audience, booking route, accessibility details and permitted recipients. Full 15 hours include agreeing and capturing these fields.
S2 retains current entry, recipient and meaning checks and manual handling of missing information. No inferred accessibility promise or automated bulk outreach is introduced.
Try native section reuse before custom code. Existing template use earns no new saving.
unknowns: Current invitation assembly effort and permitted contact groups
research_questions: Can reuse preserve correct activity details and accessibility wording while reducing assembly?

already_counted.description: Invitation details, meaning and recipient review

incremental.description: Maintain invitation defaults and contact exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact message with activity, date, time, venue, capacity, booking route, accessibility text and recipients; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100 and R=15+6+70=91 give gross 9, less 1 upkeep yields net 8. High requires repeated invitations; low assumes only 1 hour removed for bespoke events, consumed by upkeep. Live leadership retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess needs and plan activities within available facilities

steps.what: Assess the needs and interests of individuals and groups
Check and record available equipment and facilities for candidate activities
Plan activities accordingly and consider inclusion and practical limitations

tasks.design: Configure a shared resource-reference view in {DOCS} linked to existing booking information in {CALENDAR}. The worker still confirms availability and condition, captures current constraints and decides which activities meet the group's needs.
tasks.previous_blocker: Resource details are sought across booking information and scattered reference documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and filtered reference views can shorten locating information without judging suitability.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling differing interests and ensuring a plan is inclusive and feasible.
tasks.human_edge: The worker can interpret an unstated preference and change the plan when a nominally available resource is unsuitable.
tasks.altitude: Less resource-reference hunting; needs assessment and planning authority remain unchanged.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of personal service workers
reach.task: Clarify a resource constraint affecting an inclusive activity
reach.learn: Availability confirmation and escalation of access barriers

evidence.claim: Native linked references can reduce locating booking and equipment information; confirmation and suitability decisions remain human. This saving is modelled.

assumptions: Boundary is assessing needs and planning; invitation preparation and live delivery are separate.

Worker checks and records resource identifier, required interval, observed quantity, condition, access constraints, booking status, source and confirmation time in retained s2. Its 14 hours include all capture and confirmation.

Existing booking entries are produced through the normal booking process; no new external data-entry task is introduced or credited. Missing, stale or conflicting entries require manual confirmation within retained time.
The reference view displays source facts, not an automatic suitability or reservation decision.
Test native links and filters before custom code; existing lookup functions earn no incremental savings.
unknowns: Current resource-reference hunting effort and existing booking coverage
research_questions: Does a linked view reduce locating information without replacing current availability and condition checks?

already_counted.description: Resource confirmation and exact constraint capture

incremental.description: Maintain resource references and resolve stale links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100, R=40+14+40=94 gives gross 6, less 2 upkeep yields net 4. High assumes scattered references today; low assumes only 2 hours locating information can be removed, consumed by upkeep. Assessment and planning retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Inspect daily recreational facilities and discuss operational issues
Record operational issues, priorities and action ownership
Compile the daily operations action list from issue entries
Manage daily operations, resolve issues and coordinate people

tasks.design: Configure an issue table and daily filtered action view in {DOCS}. The worker still inspects, records and prioritises issues and manages responses; the view only removes a separate list-compilation pass.
tasks.previous_blocker: Daily issue entries are copied into another action list for coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filtered views can display the same recorded issues without retyping them.
tasks.still_hard: Prioritising competing operational needs and resolving situations with people present.
tasks.human_edge: The worker can judge when conditions require immediate action rather than waiting for a list update.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate list preparation; daily operational judgement remains unchanged.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of personal service workers
reach.task: Resolve an escalated facility issue with clear source context
reach.learn: Issue ownership, priority and closure evidence

evidence.claim: Native issue tables and filtered views can avoid duplicate action-list compilation; the recreation workflow and time allocation are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is day-to-day facility oversight and coordination, not the labour of maintenance colleagues or activity delivery.
Worker produces observations in s1 and enters issue ID, location, description, chosen priority, owner, due date, status and last confirmation time in s2. Full 50 hours retain observation and capture.
S3 displays recorded fields only; missing owners or dates remain explicit and are resolved manually in s4. It makes no safety or closure decision.
Test native tables and views before custom code. Existing list views earn no saving; a separate copying pass must exist.
S4 retains all review, exception handling and coordination. No repair work is transferred or claimed saved.
unknowns: Whether separate daily list copying exists
Native table access and issue ownership arrangements
research_questions: Can one recorded issue entry serve the daily view without losing urgent escalation or closure context?

incremental.description: Maintain issue fields, access and view filters

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100 and R=30+20+0+40=90 give gross 10, less 2 upkeep yields net 8. High requires duplicate daily compilation. Low assumes only 2 hours removed where existing views already work, consumed by upkeep. Operational coordination retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain time, attendance and inventory records

steps.what: Capture time and attendance facts and count inventory items
Complete time and attendance forms and inventory lists from entries
Check discrepancies and maintain the final forms and inventory lists

tasks.design: Configure direct entry and protected form views in {SPREADSHEET}, with checked records stored in {DOCS}. Capture facts once, generate separate attendance and inventory views, and retain physical counting, discrepancy checking and final confirmation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Captured facts are retyped into periodic forms and inventory lists.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tables, arithmetic and protected views can compile forms without a model or new tracking hardware.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving missing attendance, disputed intervals and unexplained inventory differences.
tasks.human_edge: The worker can verify what happened and correct the source rather than accepting a plausible total.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated record compilation; no new payroll or inventory-disposal authority.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of personal service workers
reach.task: Review a disputed attendance interval or inventory difference

evidence.claim: Native structured tables can compile attendance forms and inventory lists from captured facts; this allocation is modelled rather than measured.
Dutch works-council consent can apply to systems capable of monitoring staff performance; national rules must be checked for the deployment.

assumptions: Boundary is capturing and maintaining these records, not payroll calculation or stock purchasing. Other tasks' inventory capture must be assigned once in a roll-up.

Worker in s1 captures record type, person or item identifier, date, actual start/end and break where relevant, attendance status or observed quantity, unit, location, source and correction reason. Full 50 hours include counting, verification and entry.
S2 groups only compatible record types, units and periods; missing fields are flagged, not inferred. S3 resolves them manually and checks meaning before confirmation.
No automatic attendance feed, scanner, par level or customer self-entry is assumed. The system never changes payroll or stock on its own.
Test native tables and views before custom code; existing compilation earns no incremental saving. Restrict person-level access and assess applicable employee consultation.
unknowns: Current retyping effort and record ownership
Whether time records concern staff, participants or both
research_questions: Can direct entry preserve source corrections and access boundaries while eliminating duplicate periodic form preparation?

already_counted.description: Physical and time fact verification and capture
Meaning checks, disputes and final confirmation

incremental.description: Maintain form rules, access and correction handling

approvals.approved_version: Exact attendance and inventory snapshot with identifiers, intervals, dates, units, quantities and correction reasons; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100 and R=50+0+20=70 give gross 30, less 2 upkeep yields central net 28. High requires a separate 30-hour compilation pass. Low assumes only 2 hours removed in already linked records, consumed by upkeep. Capture, counts and discrepancy review retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep assessment, facilitation and operational decisions while reducing repeated invitations and record compilation.
reach: Give service supervisors clearer source entries for facility, attendance and inventory exceptions
role.ambitious_version: A recreation worker who can give attention to participants and resolve operational issues from clear records without repeated copying.
